notes.title: Kardiya: The Winds of Fate – Part of Dice Dimensions!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Kardiya: The Winds of Fate is part of the Dice Dimensions: Celebrating Dice-Rolling Games event!

This special event highlights the strategic depth and thrilling unpredictability of dice mechanics, and we’re excited to be a part of it.

To celebrate, we’ve uploaded new screenshots to our Steam page, giving you a fresh look at the world of Kardiya. Plus, a new demo is coming soon to itch.io! Stay tuned for more updates.

Don’t forget to add us to your wishlist so you don’t miss out on the latest news and releases!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189020/Kardiya_The_Winds_of_Fate/

notes.title: Steam Visual Novel Fest – Experience an Unforgettable Story!
notes.notes:
Hey again!

Exciting news for visual novel fans! Kardiya: The Winds of Fate is officially part of Steam Visual Novel Fest, bringing its unique storytelling, immersive world, and deep character interactions to a wider audience.

As part of the Steam Visual Novel Fest, the game will be available with special content throughout the event. We are happy to share brand new screenshots! Don't miss the chance to dive into this captivating story and explore the choices that await you!

See you next evet!

notes.title: Land of the Crescent - Games from Türkiye
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185579/a14f4f8e5d7fef593bf581a86dd13c39b3611bf8.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

We’re excited to share that our game is part of the ‘Land of the Crescent - Games from Türkiye’ event on Steam! This event highlights games made by developers from Türkiye.

This is a great chance for you to explore a variety of unique games inspired by the rich stories, cultures, and creativity of Türkiye. You’ll get to see what makes each game special—and maybe even find your next favorite!

Thank you for all your support so far. We can’t wait to see you in the Land of the Crescent!
